description: Degree subjects, including common combined subjects and generic subject options
usage_guidance: Please note this guidance from the constituent lists: , ,

field_descriptions.id: A unique identifier for this subject
field_descriptions.name: The long name of the subject, eg "accountancy"
field_descriptions.suggestion_synonyms: A list of common alternative names that may be appropriate for this subject
field_descriptions.match_synonyms: A list of common alternative names that are equivalent to this subject. An answer matching a match synonym can be safely matched to this subject.
field_descriptions.dttp_id: The ID used for this subject in DTTP
field_descriptions.hecos_code: The HESA DEGSBJ code for this degree subject (from [HECoS](https://www.hesa.ac.uk/support/documentation/hecos); see also the [DEGSBJ](https://www.hesa.ac.uk/collection/c22053/e/degsbj) documentation)
field_descriptions.subject_ids: The subject IDs of the individual single-subject parts of a combined subject
field_descriptions.generic: If present and true, indicates that this is a generic option
